_meta.indication: Treatment of chronic hepatitis B in adult patients with evidence of viral replication and either persistent elevations in serum aminotransferases (ALT or AST) or histologically active disease

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, multinational, active-controlled study of telbivudine 600 mg once daily vs lamivudine 100 mg once daily for up to 104 weeks
pivotal_trials.population: Nucleoside-naive adults (≥16 years) with HBeAg-positive or HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B, viral replication, ALT ≥1.3 x ULN, and compensated liver disease
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was Therapeutic Response at Week 52, a composite requiring HBV DNA suppression to <5 log10 copies/mL plus either loss of serum HBeAg or ALT normalization
pivotal_trials.result: In HBeAg-positive patients, 75% (telbivudine) vs 67% (lamivudine) had a Therapeutic Response (telbivudine superior); in HBeAg-negative patients, 75% vs 77% (telbivudine non-inferior)

nct_ctgov.title: A Randomized, Double Blind Trial of LdT (Telbivudine) Versus Lamivudine in Adults With Compensated Chronic Hepatitis B

key_safety: Generally well tolerated; most frequent adverse events in telbivudine-treated patients were upper respiratory tract infection (14%), fatigue/malaise (12%), abdominal pain (12%), nasopharyngitis (11%), headache (11%), and blood CPK increased (9%). Treatment-emergent Grade 3-4 creatine kinase (CK) elevations ≥7.0 x ULN occurred in 9% (telbivudine) vs 3% (lamivudine); cases of myopathy have been reported with telbivudine use several weeks to months after starting therapy
target_moa: Telbivudine is a synthetic thymidine nucleoside analogue that is phosphorylated to its active metabolite telbivudine-5'-triphosphate, which inhibits HBV DNA polymerase (reverse transcriptase) by competing with the natural substrate deoxythymidine-5'-triphosphate

**Review Priority:** Standard review

summary.text: TYZEKA (telbivudine) was a new molecular entity nucleoside analogue approved under a standard review on the basis of the pivotal Phase 3 007 GLOBE study, in which telbivudine demonstrated superiority to lamivudine in the HBeAg-positive subpopulation and non-inferiority in the HBeAg-negative subpopulation for the primary Therapeutic Response endpoint; no accelerated approval or special designations were used

citations.quote: LdT (Tyzeka™) is a new molecular entity (NME) in the nucleoside analogue class and, after phosphorylation to its active metabolite, is an inhibitor of HBV DNA polymerase. LdT 600mg once daily is indicated for the treatment of nucleoside-naïve adults with chronic HBV with evidence of active liver inflammation and compensated liver disease.
